summary.text: Dan Gosa, a Democrat, represents District 81 in the Iowa House of Representatives; the Iowa Legislature's biography, which lists Gosa as Daniel Gosa, lists Gosa as serving a first term.

paragraphs.text: The biography describes Gosa as a journeyman with the International Association of Heat and Frost Insulators and Allied Workers, executive director of the Great River Area Labor Federation, and a former president of the Davenport Community Schools Board.
It says Gosa graduated from Davenport North High School, was born in 1983 in Iowa City and lives in Davenport.
